changeRecord.title: rigid link / diaphragm added
changeRecord.target: rigid link B2.0 -> B2.1 (across member CB2.1)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A rigid constraint removes deformation the real structure has. A diaphragm that is not there forces all nodes of a level to translate and twist together, so flexible frames are propped by stiff ones; a rigid link across a member makes that member infinitely stiff, so it attracts load and stops deforming.
changeRecord.precondition: a level with at least two nodes that are not supported in the DOFs a diaphragm ties and are not part of a constraint, or a frame member whose end node is unsupported and unconstrained (plane frames modelled with out-of-plane supports at every node do not qualify)
